links.outcome: Reproducibility of outputs across three repeated retests under controlled conditions
links.effect: Item-level repeatability perfect (agreement 100%; PABAK = 1.00); response-level agreement 94-100%; PABAK 0.89-1.00.
links.quote: Item-level repeatability was perfect (agreement, 100%; PABAK = 1.00), and response-level repeatability was near-perfect (agreement, 94-100%; PABAK = 0.89-1.00).

unlisted_practices: One-question-at-a-time framework-anchored LLM workflow for structured history-taking
Content validity assessment (I-CVI, S-CVI) by expert panel

screen.reason: Evaluated patient user experience, repeatability, and content validity of a ChatGPT-assisted pain history-taking system in an observational study with 36 patients, but did not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparatively.
